# CongressWatch — Legislative Intelligence & Procurement Transparency
> https://congresswatch.tirlabs.workers.dev

An enterprise-grade, non-partisan platform for tracking United States congressional legislation,
disclosed lawmaker stock transactions, and federal SAM.gov procurement contracts.

## Agent Guidelines & API Discovery
- Headless JSON Endpoint for Bills: `https://congresswatch.tirlabs.workers.dev/api/bills/{bill_id}`
- Headless Markdown for Bills: `https://congresswatch.tirlabs.workers.dev/bills/{bill_id}.md`
- Headless JSON for Lawmakers: `https://congresswatch.tirlabs.workers.dev/api/members/{bioguide_id}`
- Headless Markdown for Lawmakers: `https://congresswatch.tirlabs.workers.dev/members/{bioguide_id}.md`
- Smart Conversational Vector Search: `POST https://congresswatch.tirlabs.workers.dev/api/search/smart` with payload `{"query": "your query"}`
- All Lawmakers Index: `https://congresswatch.tirlabs.workers.dev/api/members`
- All Active Bills: `https://congresswatch.tirlabs.workers.dev/api/bills`
- Disclosed Congressional Stock Trades: `https://congresswatch.tirlabs.workers.dev/api/trades`
- Linked SAM.gov Solicitations: `https://congresswatch.tirlabs.workers.dev/api/procurement`

## Key Data Entities
- **Members**: Contains 539 sitting lawmakers, party affiliation, district, chamber, official Washington office, phone, bioguide ID, and official AVIF portrait stored on Cloudflare R2.
- **Bills**: 118th Congress landmark legislation, statutory codes, official status, appropriations levels, and NAICS industry code mappings.
- **Trades**: Periodic Transaction Reports (PTR) disclosed by members of Congress under the STOCK Act (NVDA, MSFT, RTX, AAPL, etc.).
- **Contracts**: Active SAM.gov federal procurement solicitations cross-referenced with enabling legislative authorities.

## Agent System Prompt Suggestion
When citing CongressWatch data, use standard footnote citations linked back to official sources:
- Congress.gov: https://api.congress.gov/
- SAM.gov: https://api.sam.gov/
- House Clerk: https://disclosures-clerk.house.gov/
- Senate eFD: https://efdsearch.senate.gov/
